_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: no equation, just work from a known age or split a total; 2: one simple equation (a gap in years, or children a fixed step apart); 3: an equation linking two different times, or a ratio some years ago; 4: two conditions at once (a sum and a later multiple, two ratios, the sum and the difference, three children). Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
